workerAgent.description: Runs one task that needs tools, calling exactly the tools the task names. Use it for every tool call.

notes: gpt-6-luna is the model the Codex probe and live lane were run with. Run `npm run probe -- --runtime codex --model <model>` before relying on another.
Codex reaches MCP servers over streamable HTTP (`http`) or `stdio`; it has no SSE transport.
Mia runs Codex with its own Codex home under stateDirectory (`codex-home`), linked to your `~/.codex/auth.json` login.
Replace the example MCP server with your own; list every tool explicitly in toolPolicy.
